scoring_justification: DFT band-gap recomputation is too expensive for the verifier sandbox; result-level comparison against the paper's reported band gaps with tolerances is the feasible tier.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the band gap of the pristine GNR in eV.

outputs.description: Computed band gap of the pristine armchair graphene nanoribbon (C74H20).

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the band gap of the hybrid GNR-ZnO composite in eV.

outputs.description: Computed band gap of the hybrid GNR-ZnO composite.

output_contract.notes: Both band gaps are compared to the paper's reported values with tolerances. Additionally, the hybrid gap must be smaller than the intrinsic gap by a required margin. Full reward requires both values within tolerance and the ordering condition satisfied.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference band gaps from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's main results: intrinsic GNR band gap 1.4144 eV and hybrid GNR-ZnO band gap 0.5618 eV from Fig. 4 and text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed values; they are used as reference for tolerance-based comparison.
